layout.testBanner: Test mode: no real payments are taken. Use Stripe test cards and IBANs only.

cookieBanner.label: Cookie consent
cookieBanner.title: Cookies
cookieBanner.text: We use cookies that are needed for the site and for secure payments (Stripe fraud prevention on payment pages). We'd only use optional cookies, such as analytics, with your consent. There are none right now.

home.title: Deals
home.lead: Team up with other shoppers. When enough people join a deal, everyone gets the group price. Not enough? Nobody pays a cent.
home.step1Text: Save a card, SEPA account or iDEAL. Nothing is charged yet.
home.step2Text: Share the deal. The bar fills up as more buyers join.
home.step3Text: Minimum reached: everyone pays the group price. Not reached: nobody pays.
home.noCategoryDeals: No deals in this category right now.
home.newDealsOften: New deals are added all the time.
home.noDeals: No deals are open right now.
home.checkBack: New deals are added regularly. Check back soon.

deal.moodClose: So close! Just a few more. 🔥
deal.vatNote: Final price including VAT for every EU country. The VAT share depends on your delivery country and is calculated by Stripe Tax; the price you pay does not change.
deal.expired: This deal did not reach its minimum. Nobody was charged and all saved payment methods were removed.
deal.reached: 🎉 Minimum reached. The deal is on!
deal.closed: This deal is closed to new buyers.

deal.shareMessage: {name} · Join the group deal and we all pay less!
deal.cancelled: This deal was cancelled. Nobody was charged and all saved payment methods were removed.

join.title: Join this deal

join.name: Full name

join.errCountry: We currently deliver to EU countries only.

join.errTooMany: Too many attempts from your network. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
join.errClosed: This deal is no longer open.
join.errAlreadyJoined: This email address has already joined this deal.
join.errVat: We could not calculate VAT for this address. Please check the postcode, city and country.
join.closedBody: It is no longer possible to join. You have not been charged.

setup.title: Save your payment method
setup.noChargeHtml: No charge today. You'll only be charged if {min} buyers join by {date}. If that doesn't happen, we remove your payment method and charge nothing.
setup.reached: The minimum is reached, so we'll collect the payment right after you save your payment method.
setup.failed: That payment method couldn't be set up. Please try again or use another method.
setup.methods: Cards and SEPA Direct Debit are accepted. iDEAL is only used to set up a SEPA Direct Debit mandate from your Dutch bank account.

done.reachedHtml: The minimum is reached! We're collecting {amount} from {method} now and will email you the result.
done.willChargeHtml: We'll charge {amount} incl. VAT{vat} to {method} only if {min} buyers join by {date}.
done.buyersSoFarHtml: Buyers so far: {count} of {min}. Share the deal to help it reach the minimum: every friend who joins brings it closer. 👯
done.shareMessage: I just joined the group deal for {name}. Join too, so we all get it!
done.charging: The minimum is reached and we're collecting {amount} now. Refresh in a moment.
done.paidText: We've received {amount}. Your order is confirmed.
done.processingHtml: Direct debit started. {amount} is being collected by SEPA Direct Debit. Your place in the order is confirmed.
done.failedHtml: Your payment didn't go through. Fix it here before {date}.
done.released: This deal closed before your payment method was saved, or it didn't reach its minimum. You have not been charged and nothing is stored.
done.unpaid: Your payment couldn't be collected, so your order was cancelled. You have not been charged.
done.withdrawnRefunded: You've withdrawn from this deal. Your payment has been refunded.

assistant.subtitle: Answers by AI · usually in a few seconds

assistant.refused: Sorry, I can't help with that. I'm happy to answer questions about our deals, payment and delivery.
